title: Staging Vercel configuration verified; Auth and build blockers remain
summary: Next.js settings and 20 staging-only variables verified. Direct staging keys and fresh signing secret configured; no deployment or hosted database writes. Auth URL, provisioning and fresh build remain blocked.

changes.detail: Dedicated staging Vercel project: Next.js, Node 24.x, storefront root, npm ci, npm run build; 20 Production/Preview variables with staging identity and disabled side effects. Service and independent admin secrets marked sensitive.
Configuration guard corrected to inspect the observed shared-environment data array and pagination; earlier fail-closed attempt made no writes.

Latest checkpoint and evidence documenting Auth localhost URL, empty schema, partial hosted Auth inspection, reserved unprovisioned owner identity, disk-space blocker and separate approval gates. No existing source, history or evidence removed.

validation.name: Project identity and configuration
validation.detail: Exact project/team and domain checked before mutation; build settings and 20 variable metadata entries independently read back. Git disconnected, all-deployment protection retained. Secret values not decrypted for readback.

validation.name: Key provenance and isolation validator
validation.detail: Keys obtained from authenticated staging project API through CLI; staging ref and role claims checked; bindings and applicationEnvironment passed in memory. No production credential reuse.

validation.name: Local regression
validation.detail: 161 application, 71 worker, 4 email, 6 history tests; TypeScript; focused lint with two existing warnings; 9 browser fixture and 13 local PostgreSQL/PostgREST checks passed.

validation.name: Supabase hosted read-only checks
validation.detail: Separate staging organization and healthy project; zero public tables, users, buckets, migrations, Edge Functions, public triggers, foreign servers, subscriptions or outbound extensions. Security advisor has no findings; empty-schema result is not RLS acceptance.

validation.name: Fresh full build
validation.detail: Prebuild passed 635429 course checks; Google Fonts blocked by sandbox. Retry stopped at 1 GB disk guard with about 935 MB free. Prior successful build remains historical. Fresh HTTP smoke and clean Linux npm ci not run.

validation.name: Hosted Auth and deployment acceptance
validation.detail: Partial read-only inspection found localhost Site URL, no redirects and email confirmations enabled; full SMTP/SMS/providers/hooks not independently verified. No schema/users provisioned, deployment or real login performed.
